title: Richard Sutton warns that compute alone will not advance AI
teaser: Richard Sutton, winner of the Turing Award and author of the 2019 essay “The Bitter Lesson,” argues that more computing power alone is not enough to advance AI: new learning methods are needed. He advocates AI agents that build world models and continuously learn from their own experience. Other researchers agree that the success of scaling large language models does not prove that this approach alone will lead to more capable AI. But leaders at OpenAI and Anthropic are confident that scaling still has room to grow.
